title: IPO
description: Select at most k distinct projects to maximize capital using a max-heap for profits and a min-heap for capital constraints.
pseudocode:
1. Store projects as (capital, profit) pairs
2. Sort projects by capital
3. Use max-heap to store profits of affordable projects
4. Repeat k times:
5. Add all affordable projects to max-heap
6. Pop max profit from max-heap and add to capital

steps.note: Capital is 0. Project [0,1] is affordable. Add profit 1 to max-heap.
Pop profit 1 from max-heap. New capital = 0 + 1 = 1.
Capital is 1. Projects [1,2] and [1,3] are affordable. Add profits 2 and 3 to max-heap.
Pop max profit 3 from max-heap. New capital = 1 + 3 = 4.
